customer_message.body:
Dear Sir or Madam

Before any firm classification: After the facade renovation my rent is going up substantially; The letter gives only a total and no understandable breakdown; this is how I remember it.

Regarding “unclear renovation-related rent increase”, for this message: the subsidies remains unresolved; for the request “check recoverable costs and the deadline”: the information looks clear but leaves key questions open; on “unclear renovation-related rent increase”, my records may be out of order; also unresolved: the value adding share; that is the basis of my request.

I now need: check recoverable costs and the deadline; in particular, I need clarity about the value adding share and which detail must be confirmed before classification.

Before proceeding; Please clarify the subsidies; Only then will I know what to do.

As far as I remember, it started around 18 January 2025.

Ich kann bei Bedarf auch auf Deutsch antworten.

Best regards
customer_message.subject: Please help me decide what to do: unclear renovation-related rent increase
